build_nifti_dataset_from_folder: build a Hugging Face dataset from a folder of .nii NIfTI files using NiftiFolder
create_niftifolder_config: create a NiftiFolderConfig with drop_labels and drop_metadata options for custom dataset loading
load_nifti_with_metadata: load NIfTI files alongside metadata.csv or metadata.parquet sidecar files into a dataset
review_niftifolder_extensions: review the NiftiFolder EXTENSIONS list to confirm only .nii files are accepted
refactor_niftifolder_base_feature: refactor the NiftiFolder BASE_FEATURE to swap datasets.Nifti for a different feature type
